sentences.text:
Order 
As per office report, all the three respondents are unserved, but in view of the controversy involved in the present case, this Court is of considered opinion that this civil revision can be disposed of even in absence of respondents.

2. This civil revision under Section 115 of CPC has been filed against the award dated 05/03/2025 passed by 3rd Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Bhind, District Bhind in MACC No. 95/2023 by which applicant/insurance company was exonerated.

entities.text: 3rd Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Bhind, District Bhind
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: However, principle of "pay and recover" was applied.

3. Challenging the application of principle of "pay and recover", it is submitted by counsel for applicant that once the insurance company has been exonerated, then the Claims Tribunal should not have applied the principle of "pay and recover".
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-GWL:4477 2 CR-535-2025

5. This Court in the case of Cholamandalam MS General Insurance Company Ltd. Registered Office Royal Sundaram Gen Ins Co Ltd Gurugram vs Ranjeet Singh Kushwah on 4 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/125519039/
1

entities.text: Cholamandalam MS General Insurance Company Ltd. Registered Office Royal Sundaram Gen Ins Co Ltd Gurugram vs Ranjeet Singh Kushwah on 4 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Hari Nivas Towers Vs. Munni Bai and others decided on 11/03/2025 in MA No.5819/2024 (Gwalior) has held that even after amendment in the provisions of Motor Vehicles Act, still the Claims Tribunal has jurisdiction to apply the principle of "pay and recover".
6.

entities.text: Hari Nivas Towers Vs. Munni Bai and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Since the case in hand is duly covered by the order passed by this Court in the case of Munni Bai (supra) , therefore, this Court is of considered opinion that no case is made out warranting interference in the impugned award.

7 . Ex-consequenti, award dated 05/03/2025 passed by 3 rd Motor Accident Claims Tribunal,
Bhind, District Bhind in MACC No. 95/2023 is hereby affirmed.

entities.text:
Motor Accident Claims Tribunal,
Bhind, District Bhind
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 8. Civil revision fails and is hereby dismissed.
However, it is observed that dismissal of this revision would not mean that this Court has upheld the quantum of compensation amount or exoneration of the insurance company.

Therefore, it is observed that in case if the owner of offending vehicle files a civil revision against the exoneration of insurance company or the claimant files a miscellaneous appeal for enhancement of compensation amount, then this order will not come in the way of such proceedings.

(G. S. AHLUWALIA) JUDGE AKS Royal Sundaram Gen Ins Co Ltd Gurugram vs Ranjeet Singh Kushwah on 4 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/125519039/
